message: Hi Alex, it's Maria at Bright Dentistry, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Maria, thanks for replying. I can't promise a specific number of new customers - no honest web person can, since bookings depend on more than the site. What I can do is fix the issues actually holding your site back for $900 one-time, reviewed by me, not just AI-generated. If you want, I'll send the audit findings first so you can see what's broken before deciding.
